parsing_traps: Page 34 per-property Gross Revenue / Property Expenses / NPI table contains DUPLICATED rows for Tiong Bahru Plaza, Century Square, Hougang Mall and White Sands with conflicting values (parser artifact). Correct set verified by reconciling against the reported totals (e.g. GR: TBP 44,502 / CS 35,886 / HM 27,124 / WS 31,635 sums exactly to 389,603 with the other properties); the second duplicate set (44,504/36,545/24,545/33,553) does not reconcile and was discarded.

Portfolio overview table (pp. 68-69) is rendered twice with colspan misalignment: NLA/occupancy/traffic values shift across the Northpoint City North/South Wing columns. Per-property NLA was instead taken from the individual property profile pages (70-88), and per-property occupancy from the dedicated committed occupancy table on p29.

Northpoint City is reported as one income line (North Wing + South Wing + Yishun 10 Retail Podium) in the FY25 revenue/NPI tables, but as two separate properties (per wing) in the audited Portfolio Statement; per-wing GR/NPI set to null to avoid imputation.

NEX and Waterway Point revenue, NPI and valuation are disclosed on a 100.0% basis although FCT holds 50.0%; they sit outside 'Gross Revenue' in the audited statements (equity-accounted joint ventures) so must NOT be added to the reported gross revenue of $389.6m. FCT's 50% share of valuations: NEX $1,070.5m, Waterway Point $665.5m (p37 footnotes).

2H FY25 DPU of 6.059 cents is split into two declared distributions (0.096 cents for 1-3 Apr 2025 and 5.963 cents for 4 Apr-30 Sep 2025) due to the April 2025 equity fund raising; do not double count.

Two 'Distributions to Unitholders' style figures exist: distributable income for the financial year $233,180k vs distributions to Unitholders declared $233,166k (Distribution Statement, p147); net_distributable_income uses $233,180k.
Hougang Mall occupancy (73.5%, p68) is excluded from the committed-occupancy table on p29 (and from the 98.1% Retail Portfolio figure footnote) due to ongoing AEI since April 2025.
Property expenses note combines 'Maintenance and utilities' in one line; mapped to component 'maintenance' with label_raw preserved (schema canonical list separates utilities and maintenance).
Changi City Point shows residual FY25 GR of $42k and expenses of -$210k from post-divestment adjustments despite being divested 31 Oct 2023.

Top-10-tenant and trade-mix percentages are based on Retail Portfolio GRI (includes JV malls NEX and Waterway Point, excludes office property Central Plaza), a different denominator from the SGD gross revenue in the audited statements.

reconciliation.note: Sums use the p34 audited-portfolio breakdown: Causeway Point 97,704 + Northpoint City (combined, incl. South Wing & Yishun 10) 85,573 + Tampines 1 54,990 + Tiong Bahru Plaza 44,502 + Century Square 35,886 + Hougang Mall 27,124 + White Sands 31,635 + Central Plaza 12,147 + Changi City Point adjustment 42 = 389,603 ($'000); NPI reconciles identically to 277,980. property_count = 9 owned investment properties at 30 Sep 2025 (Northpoint City wings counted separately per Portfolio Statement); additionally 2 JV properties (NEX, Waterway Point at 50%) and 1 property divested during the year (Yishun 10).
